description: ID-One Cosmo V8.1 is a dual interface (ISO 7816 & ISO 14443) smartcard chip compliant with Javacard 3.0.4 and GlobalPlatform 2.2.1 chip which supports RSA (including RSA-CRT) encrypt/decrypt and digital signature generation /verification with keys from 64 to 4096-bit by step of 32-bit.
version: HW = ‘30’ with FW = ‘5F01’ and HW = '40' with FW = '6001' 07888.16 (Firmware)
